name: nGZSceneGraph::NodeRefreshWorldTransforms
notes: Lane OP. Hooked (cdecl on a node; 43 game callers, and our cBoundedNodeImpl::RefreshIfStale and cSceneNode's flush, which call ours): climbs to the topmost ancestor whose flag 12 is set, gives it its world transform (its parent's slot 54, the identity without a parent, through its slot 57) and walks the subtrees below it (src/sg/SGWorldTransformRefresh.h). Ours keeps its work lists in a static of ours (the game's function-local static 0x10f5fac-0x10f5fe8 is no longer touched), with the game's record layout where slot 60 sees it. SG_WorldTransformRefresh: per seed 1-40 flag node fakes in a tree (random flags, mostly the stale and content bits; limits 0, 0x7fffffff or small; slot 41 ranges that end at a child; slot 57 writing every float from what it is handed), the refresh on 1-3 random nodes, and in a quarter of the seeds a slot 60 that runs the refresh again (once) on another node while the first is still listing (the shared lists); every slot call logged in order, slot 60 with the 7 floats of its transform, the limit records (8 words each) and their count. Mutants (tools/mutate.py --filter SG_WorldTransformRefresh, 2026-10-28): 20 on src/sg/SGWorldTransformRefresh.cpp, 20 killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::RefreshWorldTransformsBelow
notes: Lane OP, test: 0xa39b70's entry. The walk below a node (cdecl: node, world, the work lists): content node (flag 4) listed or its slot 60 at once; each child's world transform through its slot 57; a limit-0 child a new root, else its limit listed (unless 0x7fffffff) and the walk goes on. Called only by 0xa39b70 (hooked) and itself.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cWorldTransformWork::AddRoot
notes: Lane OP, test: 0xa39b70's entry. Appends {node, world} to the root list (thiscall on the work lists, ret 8; grown one record at a time through std::vector _Resize when its count reaches its size). Ours: push_back on our list. Called only by 0xa39b70 and 0xa39a10.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cWorldTransformWork::AddContent
notes: Lane OP, test: 0xa39b70's entry. Appends {node, world} to the content list (as 0xa39500). Called only by 0xa39a10.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cWorldTransformWork::AddLimit
notes: Lane OP, test: 0xa39b70's entry. Appends {limit, world} to the limit list (thiscall, ret 8; the list starts as 50 records {0x7fffffff, identity}, grown by one record, resize inline, when full). Ours: push_back on a list with room for 50. Called only by 0xa39b70 and 0xa39a10.

name: nGZSceneGraph::NodeRefreshWorldTransforms_work_atexit
notes: Lane OP. The atexit destructor of 0xa39b70's function-local work lists (frees the three vectors). Only 0xa39b70's first run registers it (its address there, not a call), so with 0xa39b70 hooked nothing registers or reaches it; ours is our own static's destructor. Held at mapped: an exit handler is not reached by a differential test (the original side's lists live in the test's RefreshScope memory, which its frees cannot take).
